attributes.action: Stop the London to Brighton bike ride being held on Father’s Day every year
attributes.additional_details: Every year for as long as I can remember it has been held on Father’s Day. For a lot of families it makes it impossible to make plans to celebrate the day with their loved ones. It means each year a lot of people are confined to their homes on a day that they may not want to. I can understand every now and then that it falls on that day but every year is not fair. I fully support the bike ride to raise money for charities but there are plenty of other weekends to choose from.
attributes.background: I want to stop the London to Brighton bike ride being held on Father’s Day every year. Every year for as long as I can remember it has been held on Father’s Day. Having spoke to many people on this subject it is clear that a lot if people feel the same.

rejection.details:
Decisions about the London to Brighton bike ride are a matter for the organisers, not the UK Government or Parliament.

You could ask your MP to take action on your concerns about this issue.

You can find contact details for your local MP here: https://members.parliament.uk/FindYourMP

You could also raise your issue with a local councillor who represents you. You can use this page to find out who your local councillors are, and how to contact them: https://www.gov.uk/find-your-local-councillors
